mapper.insert: INSERT INTO paid_coupon_inventory(coupon_id, total, remaining, next_unit_id) VALUES (#{couponId}, #{total}, #{remaining}, #{nextUnitId})
mapper.select: SELECT i.coupon_id AS couponId, i.total AS total, i.remaining AS remaining, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paid_coupon_available_unit a WHERE a.coupon_id = i.coupon_id) AS SIGNED) AS availableCount, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paid_coupon_reserved_unit r WHERE r.coupon_id = i.coupon_id) AS SIGNED) AS reservedCount FROM paid_coupon_inventory i WHERE i.coupon_id = #{couponId}
